display_title: I'm Having a Crush on a Goblin
description:
TiYuri, who has never had a face, a family, or an ability since birth, Her only concern is the mysterious existence of a goblin! A demon that she thought was a fantasy and couldn't usually dream of appeared in her life. Isn't the new employee goblin you encountered at work being sued for sexual harassment if you say this wrong? I can't, so I'm going to have to stalk you openly from now on!
